handbook.summary: How-tos for the dealer portal. Sidebar matches Selling, Operations, and Support.

features.title: Support
features.details: Request a change and Devrecated Solutions.

steps.name: Sign-in
steps.purpose: Acme Fleet has no password on the public demo. You pick a seeded teammate. That account’s role decides which nav items, cost columns, and edit controls you get.
steps.lookOut: The card lists active teammates. Dana Whitfield is Administrator. A sales rep will not see cost or margin. Finance will not see leads.
how: Open `/sign-in`.
Wait until the Choose an account list shows **Dana Whitfield**.
Pick that row to enter the portal as Administrator.
steps.roles: Everyone who uses the demo. The teammate you pick is the role you work as.
steps.caption: Account picker — seeded teammates, no password.

steps.name: Dashboard
steps.purpose: The dashboard is the morning screen: units in stock, inventory value, open pipeline, applications awaiting credit, a featured car, follow-ups, and recent applications.
steps.lookOut: You should see **Units in stock** with a live count, a featured vehicle, follow-ups, and recent applications — the morning desk for the showroom.
how: Sign in as **Dana Whitfield** (Administrator).
Open **Dashboard** (`/`).
Review Units in stock, Inventory value, Open pipeline, and Awaiting credit.
Use **Next follow-ups** and **Recent applications** when you need to jump into Leads or Financing.
steps.roles: Administrator, Sales manager, Sales rep, Finance, and Viewer.
steps.caption: Home dashboard — stock, pipeline, featured unit, and follow-ups.
tips: Tap the featured unit when you want to open that vehicle in Inventory.
Follow-ups and recent applications are shortcuts into Leads and Financing.

controls.notes: Leads with the soonest scheduled touch

seeAlso.note: The lot behind the stock counts

steps.name: Inventory
steps.purpose: Inventory is the showroom book. Use it to find units, switch gallery or list, filter by status, open a car, and add or edit when your role allows.
steps.lookOut: The page title is **Inventory**. As Administrator you should see **Add vehicle** and seeded stock — Lamborghini, Ferrari, Porsche, McLaren, and Bentley. **Add vehicle** alone is the header; it is on screen while the lot is still skeletons.
how: Open **Inventory** from the nav (`/inventory`).
Confirm cars have loaded — a Lamborghini card, not skeletons.
Search or apply a status chip when you need a subset.
Toggle gallery vs list.
Open a card for the detail sheet, or **Add vehicle** when you have edit permission.
steps.roles: Everyone can view inventory. Administrator, Sales manager, and Sales rep can add or edit. Cost and margin stay hidden from Sales rep and Viewer.
steps.caption: Gallery — search, status chips, and vehicle cards.
tips: Most “missing car” moments are an active status chip or a leftover search.
Cost and margin only appear for roles with cost visibility.

controls.notes: All, Available, Reconditioning, In transit, Pending sale, Sold

seeAlso.note: Stock counts on the home screen
Pipeline after a unit is in play

steps.name: Navigate & filter
steps.purpose: Find the right cars quickly with search, status chips, and gallery vs list — before you open a unit or add one.
steps.lookOut: Typing a model name should shrink the grid. **Available** hides pending and sold. **List** shows stock number and asking price in a table. **All** returns every unit.
how: Open **Inventory**.
Type a model fragment into search (for example `Huracán`).
Set a status chip — **Available** for cars you can sell from.
Toggle **List** then **Gallery**.
Click **All** when you need the full book.
steps.roles: Anyone with inventory view. Spec options follow what is on the lot.
steps.caption: Search, Available, and list vs gallery.
tips: Most “missing car” moments are an active status chip or a leftover search.
List view is the faster scan when you care about stock number and asking price.

controls.notes: All / Available / Sold and the rest
Does not change which cars match

seeAlso.note: Open a card after you filter

steps.name: Vehicle detail
steps.purpose: The detail sheet is one car: photo, VIN, asking price, status, and — for roles with cost visibility — margin. Edit and delete sit on the sheet when you have inventory.edit.
steps.lookOut: Opening the Huracán EVO card should show VIN `ZHWUC1ZD8MLA10421` and asking price. Administrator sees cost and margin. Do not use Delete on the demo lot.
how: Open **Inventory**.
Click a vehicle card (the 2023 Lamborghini Huracán EVO is the seeded first unit).
Read stock number, VIN, asking price, and status.
Close the sheet when you are done. Use **Edit** only when you mean to change the record.
steps.roles: Anyone who can view inventory. Edit and delete need inventory.edit. Cost and margin need inventory.viewCost.
steps.caption: Detail sheet — photo, VIN, asking price, and status.
tips: The sheet is the safe read. **Edit** and **Delete** change the lot.
Reps and viewers will not see cost.

controls.notes: Mutates the lot — skip on the demo

steps.name: Leads
steps.purpose: Leads is the sales pipeline as a kanban. Drag a card to change stage. **New lead** opens a form. Stage changes last for the session on this demo.
steps.lookOut: The page title is **Leads**. As Administrator you should see **New lead** and seeded cards such as Gideon Volkov. **New lead** alone is the header; it is on screen while the columns are still empty.
how: Open **Leads** from the nav (`/leads`).
Wait until **Gideon Volkov** is on the board.
Read columns New through Lost.
Drag a card only when you mean to move the deal. Use **New lead** to capture an inquiry — Cancel if you are only touring.
steps.roles: Administrator, Sales manager, Sales rep, and Viewer. Finance does not see leads.
steps.caption: Kanban — columns, seeded cards, New lead.
tips: A drag is a stage change. Do not demo-drag production-like data if you care about the board staying put.
Viewer can see the board; edit is withheld.

controls.notes: Needs leads.edit; Cancel to leave the lot unchanged

seeAlso.note: People and companies behind the cards

steps.name: New lead
steps.purpose: New lead captures an inquiry and puts it on the board. The demo form is real — Cancel unless you mean to add a card.
steps.lookOut: The dialog title is **New lead**. You should see Contact name, Company, Email, Phone, and Stage. **Cancel** closes without writing.
how: Open **Leads**.
Click **New lead**.
Read the fields. Leave them empty on a tour.
Click **Cancel** (or close) so the board stays as seeded.
steps.roles: Administrator, Sales manager, and Sales rep. Viewer does not get New lead.
steps.caption: New lead dialog — fields, then Cancel so the demo lot is unchanged.
tips: Saving creates a card. Tours should Cancel.

steps.name: CRM
steps.purpose: CRM is the people book: contacts and companies, stage, owner, and a detail sheet. It is not the kanban — Leads is the deal board.
steps.lookOut: You should see **Contacts** and **Companies** tabs and a seeded contact such as Alonzo Reyes. Empty chrome means the list has not loaded.
how: Open **CRM** (`/crm`).
Stay on **Contacts** and wait for names.
Search when the list is long.
Open a row for the contact sheet. Switch to **Companies** for the account list.
steps.roles: Administrator, Sales manager, Sales rep, and Viewer. Finance does not see CRM.
steps.caption: Contacts table — search, stage chips, and rows.
tips: Leads is the pipeline. CRM is who they are.

steps.name: Companies
steps.purpose: Companies is the account list beside Contacts. Open it when you need the firm, not the person.
steps.lookOut: The **Companies** tab should list **Meridian Private Office** and the other seeded accounts.
how: Open **CRM**.
Click **Companies**.
Search if needed.
Open a row when you want the account sheet.
steps.caption: Companies tab — Meridian Private Office and the rest of the book.

steps.name: Financing
steps.purpose: Financing is the credit desk: applications, status, lender, and a detail sheet. Search and status chips narrow the queue.
steps.lookOut: You should see applications such as **Azure Yacht & Auto** and status chips including **In review**. Header stats load with the table.
how: Open **Financing** (`/financing`).
Wait for application rows.
Filter by status when you are working a queue.
Open a row for the sheet. Edit only with financing.edit.
steps.roles: Administrator, Sales manager, and Finance. Sales rep and Viewer do not see Financing.
steps.caption: Applications table — search, status chips, seeded rows.
tips: In review is the live queue. Funded is history.

seeAlso.note: Awaiting credit on the home screen

steps.name: Users
steps.purpose: Users is the roster: teammates, roles, status, and invite. Role on each row is what the sign-in picker is simulating.
steps.lookOut: You should see **Dana Whitfield** as Administrator. **Invite** is Administrator-only.
how: Open **Users** (`/users`).
Wait for the roster.
Search or filter by Active / Invited / Suspended.
Do not invite or delete on the public demo unless you mean to change the roster.
steps.roles: Administrator and Sales manager can view. Only Administrator can invite or edit.
steps.caption: Roster — names, roles, Active filter.
tips: The sign-in picker is this roster. Changing a role here changes what that teammate can see.
